name: Miguel Marôco Concert
description: Composer and multi-instrumentalist Miguel Marôco performs an intimate, free concert at the Casa da Música Café, a perfect way to spend your Thursday evening.
longDescription:
Composer and multi-instrumentalist Miguel Marôco presents a concert at the Casa da Música Café on April 16, 2026. Marôco, known for his diverse musical background, brings his original compositions to the stage. His work often incorporates elements from various genres, reflecting his versatility as a musician. This performance offers an opportunity to hear his unique sound in a relaxed setting.

The concert is scheduled for 9:30 PM, providing an evening activity in Porto. The Casa da Música Café offers an intimate atmosphere, suitable for a musical performance. The event is open to all and is free of charge, making it accessible to a broad audience interested in contemporary music. The duration of the concert is typical for a café performance.

Admission to the concert is free, and walk-ins are welcome. The Casa da Música is located near the Casa da Música metro station, served by lines A, B, C, E, and F, making it easily reachable from various parts of Porto. The venue is generally accessible.
